SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a bar graph of sub-county populations, which sub-county has the tallest bar? (1 mark)
   A. The smallest area
   B. The one with the most people
   C. The largest area
   D. The one with the fewest people

2. Which is the right way to make a complaint? (1 mark)
   A. By spreading rumours
   B. By fighting
   C. By shouting in class
   D. Through your class representative

3. What is forgiveness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring the wrong
   B. Keeping anger forever
   C. Choosing to let go of anger against someone who wronged you
   D. Punishing without listening

4. Which monument in Nairobi remembers Kenya's independence in 1963? (1 mark)
   A. Lamu Fort
   B. Fort Jesus
   C. Uhuru Gardens
   D. Thimlich Ohinga

5. How do industries help farmers? (1 mark)
   A. They cut farms
   B. They teach only
   C. They buy the farmers' produce
   D. They stop rain

6. What is personal protective equipment used for? (1 mark)
   A. To make noise
   B. To protect a person from harm
   C. To slow down work
   D. To hide

7. What does majority mean? (1 mark)
   A. The smaller number of votes
   B. A tie
   C. The larger number of votes
   D. No votes

8. Who helps at weddings and funerals in many communities? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody
   B. Only the police
   C. Neighbours and relatives
   D. Only the government

9. What is harambee? (1 mark)
   A. A school subject
   B. A kind of market
   C. A type of crop
   D. Working together to solve a problem

10. Which of these is a school value? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Stealing
   C. Bullying
   D. Honesty

11. Why is traditional culture important? (1 mark)
   A. It has no use
   B. It makes people fight
   C. It stops all change
   D. It gives identity and teaches values

12. Which game is played with seeds or stones moved between holes in a board? (1 mark)
   A. Netball
   B. Football
   C. Bao
   D. Athletics

13. Which is the longest river inside Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Yala River
   B. Tana River
   C. Athi River
   D. Nzoia River

14. What does jua kali mean in Kiswahili? (1 mark)
   A. Hot sun
   B. Big factory
   C. Rainy day
   D. Cold wind

15. Where does a river usually start? (1 mark)
   A. In a lake
   B. On the beach
   C. On high land
   D. In the desert

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how a losing candidate should behave and why. (3 marks)

17. Explain the difference between the governor and the president. (3 marks)

18. A bar graph shows sub-county A has 40 thousand people and sub-county B has 25 thousand. Find the total population of the two sub-counties. (3 marks)

19. Explain how a historic place such as Fort Jesus helps local people to earn a living. (4 marks)

20. Explain why a ballot should be secret. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — The one with the most people
   Taller bars show bigger values.

2. D — Through your class representative
   Use proper channels.

3. C — Choosing to let go of anger against someone who wronged you
   Forgiveness ends quarrels.

4. C — Uhuru Gardens
   Uhuru Gardens is where the Kenyan flag was first raised at independence.

5. C — They buy the farmers' produce
   Factories need farm produce as raw materials.

6. B — To protect a person from harm
   PPE protects the wearer.

7. C — The larger number of votes
   Majority means more than others.

8. C — Neighbours and relatives
   People help by cooking, lending items and comforting.

9. D — Working together to solve a problem
   Harambee means pulling together.

10. D — Honesty
   Honesty is a positive value.

11. D — It gives identity and teaches values
   Culture helps us to know who we are.

12. C — Bao
   Bao is a board game with seeds.

13. B — Tana River
   The Tana River is the longest river in Kenya.

14. A — Hot sun
   Jua kali means hot sun, from workers who work outdoors.

15. C — On high land
   Rivers start on high land and flow to lower land.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Accept the result peacefully, congratulate the winner and offer to help. This keeps peace and shows respect for democracy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: The president leads the national government of the whole country. The governor leads one county government.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each description and 1 mark for the difference.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: 65 thousand, which is 65,000 people.
   Working / marking points: 40 + 25 = 65 thousand. 1 mark for adding, 1 mark for 65 thousand, 1 mark for 65,000.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Visitors pay entry fees, guides are employed, hotels and restaurants get customers, and craft sellers sell to tourists.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: So that nobody can force or influence how a person votes, so the choice is free.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.
